integrity: Algebraic proofs are self-contained for the new coefficientwise and Frobenius-orbit assertions; the standard-library finite checker corroborates only enumerated fields.
scientific_limitations: Broader supersingular moduli classification, general elliptic splitting, and the explicit supersingular elliptic quotient equations of Nart--Ritzenthaler Proposition 2.5 are prior; the chart-specific Galois descent census and all-q orbit zeta formula are the restricted proposed contribution. Priority against equivalent published descent formulations remains uncertain.
scientific_scope: The natural coefficientwise Newton strata of smooth characteristic-two genus-three Picard quartics together with a complete Frobenius splitting-type census and the full finite-field orbit-induced zeta formula, including nonrational involutions.
title: Characteristic-two Picard quartics: Newton strata and Frobenius-orbit zeta factors
